shots.detail_en: War room floor; extreme macro close-up of a single ant crawling across a glass jar lid, Changhong in white shirt crouching low watching it
shots.sub: 长虹：「熊伟的机器，吃得准每一个人。」
shots.speaker: CH
shots.fx: amplified tiny ant steps + low hum

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Changhong's fingertip taps lightly beside the jar lid; the ant crawls around his finger without scattering
shots.sub: 长虹（低）：「它吃的是先跑的那一个。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Medium shot: Mancang and Hongli lean in; three people crouch in a circle around the jar lid on the floor
shots.sub: 满仓：「看蚂蚁能看出钱来？」红利：「他在说我们。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Changhong lifts his head, eyes fixed and calm — the golden-line moment
shots.sub: 长虹：「它算得准每一个人。它算不准——所有人。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Quick-cut montage: a stack of handwritten rosters / the first hand-drawn K-line chart on the wall / three pairs of hands pressing three corners of a chart
shots.sub: 旁白：「同盟三日，名册厚了三指，墙上的线长了一寸。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Medium shot: Hongli flips open an old ledger with yellowed, curled page corners
shots.sub: 红利：「十年里三回散户抱团，全死在第三天——总有人偷偷先跑。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up of the old ledger page: three old dates circled in red ink, imagery only, no readable figures
Two-shot: Changhong slides a bank passbook to the center of the table; Hongli raises her eyes to him
shots.sub: 长虹：「我的钱先躺进去——跑的人和躺着的人，不一样。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Hongli studies the number on the passbook, her eyelashes flicker once
shots.sub: 红利：「账上写着呢——你先躺，我们才敢站。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Wide shot: Mancang pours a few old pager samples from a hemp sack onto the table, rubbing his hands
shots.sub: 满仓：「这几台是样品，先练手——」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Medium shot: Mancang holds one pager up and sweeps it through the air like a beacon, eyes shining
shots.sub: 满仓：「人传人慢，BP机快——到时候嘀一声，全厅都听见！把全厅的BP机全租下来，当咱们的信号塔！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up two-shot: Changhong and Hongli exchange one glance and each give a small nod
shots.sub: 长虹：「塔的事，等信号齐了再说。」红利：「账我先记着。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Burst wide shot: three people each hold one corner of a giant hand-drawn K-line chart, unfolding it against the wall — the wall slowly filling into a war map
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: a nail bites into the paper corner; a red pen draws a rising dotted line on the chart
Medium pan: three step back to look at the wall; charts and old ledger pages overlap like a battle map
shots.sub: 旁白：「一面墙，一摞账，一群不肯先跑的人。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Hongli starts a new line on a fresh ledger page, pen tip hovering above the paper
shots.sub: 红利：「联华网络的对倒量——」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Slow close-up: Hongli's pupils tighten, fingertip pressing down on the page
shots.sub: 红利：「又翻了一倍——还在翻。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Changhong leans over the ledger page, his expression turning calm instead
shots.sub: 长虹：「别惊动他。让他把网织完——网越大，越收不了口。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Late-night close-up: Changhong stands alone before the wall, pocket-watch chain hanging over the chart's edge
Medium shot: Mancang asleep against the door frame hugging pager samples; Hongli drapes a coat over his shoulders
Black screen next-episode card with white bold text
shots.sub: 字幕：「联华网络——他饿坏了。」
